title: Compact BedWars HUD
description: A compact client-side BedWars HUD with TNT timers, resource counters, stack overlays, potion timers and a round kill counter.
body:
Compact BedWars HUD is a lightweight client-side HUD mod made for BedWars players.

It adds useful round information directly to your screen without changing gameplay mechanics. The goal is to keep important BedWars information compact, clean and easy to read during matches.

Features

TNT Timers
Shows a timer for nearby primed TNT so you can react before it explodes.

Resource Counters
Displays your current amount of iron, gold, diamonds and emeralds in a compact HUD next to the hotbar.

Stack Overlays
Shows item stack amounts more clearly above items, making it easier to keep track of blocks, resources and utility items.

Round Kill Counter
Adds a small kill counter with a skull-style display, so you can see how many kills you got during the current round.

Potion Timers
Shows active potion effect timers in a clean overlay.

HUD Editor
Includes a built-in HUD editor for moving and customizing overlay elements.

Customization

You can adjust HUD element positions and change visual options such as accent color, text color and background visibility.

Important Notice

This is a client-side HUD mod. It does not add combat automation, aim assist, reach, movement hacks, x-ray or any other unfair gameplay automation.

Some servers may have their own rules about HUD helper mods. Always check the server rules before using it.

Compatibility

Minecraft: 1.21.11
Loader: Fabric
Required: Fabric API
